$comment: THE FLEET'S LSP REGISTRY — one source of truth for every surface that runs a
language server. Consumers, all reading THIS file:
nix/home/core.nix        -> home.packages (the host-global servers)
nix/home/ai.nix          -> the generated Claude Code marketplace (lspServers)
advl/nvim Dockerfile.base-> the npm pin line (via the vendored copy)
advl/nvim lua/config/lsp -> prefer_local resolution + the enable list
WHY JSON AND NOT NIX: the nvim image is Ubuntu + npm and cannot evaluate nix,
so a .nix registry could never reach it. JSON is the only interlingua all four
consumers can read. nix does builtins.fromJSON, bash does jq, lua does
vim.json.decode.
WHAT THIS REPLACES: four hand-maintained lists that mirrored each other by
comment and had already drifted — basedpyright was 1.39.3 on the host against
1.39.8 in the image (measured 2026-08-03).
FIELDS
id                  stable key; also the Claude lspServers entry name
nixPackages         nixpkgs attrs for the HOST (helix + host editing + CC)
npm                 exact pins for the nvim IMAGE. null = not npm-installed
(lua_ls is a tarball, nil comes from nixpkgs only)
command / args      how to spawn it. Claude forbids spaces in command.
preferLocal         resolve <root>/node_modules/.bin/<command> FIRST when
present. Only meaningful for npm-delivered servers.
nvim                vim.lsp.enable() name, or null if the image omits it
hostOnly            true = never baked into the image
extensionToLanguage Claude Code's required map. Values are LANGUAGE IDS
(LSP spec), not filetypes.
